messages:
maria (docs): opened a micro-PR to add a 1-page provisioning playbook for Dedicated: quick checklist, where to find terraform snippets, a tiny SDK example, and a short note about scalePolicy v2 migration. CI is failing link-check + markdown-lint. can someone triage? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521

sam (infra): i can take links. which ones are blowing up?

maria (docs): the legacy terraform snippet URL and an old scalepolicy overview 404. i linked to infra/examples/terraform-reserved-pools in the PR but the old path is in a few other docs too.

carla (platform): i will put a redirect in place for the scalepolicy page to /guides/autoscale/v2 and update other references. also recommend a one-line migration checklist: "set cooldown >= 30s and validate with reserved-pool smoke test."

jordan (eng): lint: code fences need language tags and a python import uses old client name. i'll push a tiny fix: change to Client().provision_dedicated and add ```python and ```go fences.

maria (docs): thanks. can we keep SDK snippets very small? two-line examples are perfect. i put a sample but happy to swap.

sam (infra): drop-in py snippet (two lines):
```python
from redwood import Client
Client().provision_dedicated("team-foo", "isolated")
```
sam (infra): and go: 
```go
client := sdk.New()
client.ProvisionDedicated("team-foo", "isolated")
```

jordan (eng): updated import + language tags, wrapped long lines. carla, once you add redirect i'll re-run link-check.

carla (platform): redirect and terraform link updates live. also added a short paragraph in the playbook on "isolated vs shared" guidance (isolated = compliance/guaranteed tenancy; shared = cost-efficient).

docs-bot: PR #4521 status 6a7 checks: link-check (running), lint (running)

sam (infra): link-check passed. lint had one nit (TOC heading case) which maria just fixed. approving after that.

maria (docs): fixed TOC capitalization and added a one-line migration bullet: "validate cooldowns in v2 using infra/scripts/provision_smoke.sh". merging once build passes.

docs-bot: PR #4521 merged by maria (docs) 389 all checks passed.

maria (docs): follow-up: i'll open an issue to port the py/go snippets into the quickstart templates so examples stay synced. thanks all, closing thread.
